setup.storageTitle: Ritu can't save on this device
setup.storageBody: Storage is turned off, maybe because this is a private window. Open Ritu in a normal window, or free up some space, then try again.

disclaimer: Predictions are estimates, not medical advice and not birth control.
privacy: Everything stays on this phone. No account, no internet, nothing is shared.

today.flagBanner: Something in her recent cycles may be worth checking with a doctor.

confidence.low_other: Low confidence: log a few more periods

log.flowHint: Very heavy means changing a pad every 1–2 hours
log.privateHint: Only on this profile. Never shown in reports; left out when someone else manages the profile.
log.nearbyBody: A period already started on {{date}}, less than 10 days away.

calendar.empty: Add a profile to see her calendar.

insights.empty: Insights appear after she logs her periods.
insights.needTwo: Log two periods to see cycle lengths.
insights.needEnded: Mark when periods end to see their length.
insights.heatmapHint: Darker means she had it on that day in more of her cycles.
insights.noSymptoms: Log symptoms to see patterns here.
insights.seeDoctor: Consider seeing a doctor. This is not a diagnosis.
insights.reportFailed: Couldn't make the report. Please try again.

cycle_length.title: Cycles shorter or longer than usual
cycle_length.noticed: Her last 3 cycles were each shorter than 21 days or longer than the usual range.
cycle_length.why: Cycles that are often very short or very long can be linked to hormone or thyroid changes, stress or other conditions a doctor can check.

irregular.title: Irregular cycles
irregular.noticed: Her recent cycle lengths vary more than is typical for her age.
irregular.why: Very irregular cycles can have many causes, such as PCOS, thyroid changes or stress.

long_period.title: Long periods
long_period.noticed: At least 2 of her last 3 periods lasted more than 7 days.
long_period.why: Bleeding for more than a week can lead to low iron (anaemia) and is worth checking.

missed.title: No period for over 90 days
missed.noticed: No period has been logged for more than 3 months.
missed.why: Missing periods can be caused by pregnancy, weight change, stress, PCOS or thyroid changes.

heavy_flow.title: Very heavy flow
heavy_flow.noticed: Very heavy flow was logged in at least 2 of her last 3 cycles.
heavy_flow.why: Very heavy bleeding can cause anaemia and tiredness. A doctor can help.

severe_pain.title: Severe period pain
severe_pain.noticed: Pain of 8 or more out of 10 was logged in at least 2 of her last 3 cycles.
severe_pain.why: Pain that stops daily life is not something to put up with. Conditions like endometriosis can be treated.

between_bleeding.title: Bleeding between periods
between_bleeding.noticed: Bleeding or spotting was logged between periods in at least 2 of her last 3 cycles.
between_bleeding.why: Bleeding between periods has many causes and is worth checking with a doctor.

missed_log.title: A period may be missing ({{date}})
missed_log.noticed: The cycle starting {{date}} is about twice her usual length, so a period may not have been logged.
missed_log.why: Add the missing period in the calendar so predictions stay accurate.

period_not_ended.title: Period still marked as ongoing
period_not_ended.noticed: The period that started {{date}} has no end day yet.
period_not_ended.why: Set its last day so predictions stay accurate.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save a file with every unlocked profile, to keep safe or to move to a new phone. Uninstalling Ritu deletes all data on this phone.
backup.nothing: All profiles are locked. Unlock them first.
backup.skippedLocked_one: 1 locked profile was left out. Unlock it to include it.
backup.skippedLocked_other: {{count}} locked profiles were left out. Unlock them to include them.
backup.invalid: That file isn't a Ritu backup.
backup.confirmBody_one: This adds 1 profile ({{names}}). If it is already on this phone, it is replaced.
backup.confirmBody_other: This adds {{count}} profiles ({{names}}). Any already on this phone are replaced.

settings.profilesHint: Reminders, PIN, export and delete are set per profile.

what.title: What Ritu stores
what.body: The names, birth years, periods, symptoms, moods, notes and settings you enter. Nothing else. Ritu has no account and collects no device IDs, location or contacts.

where.title: Where it is stored
where.body: Only on this phone, inside the app. Ritu has no server. It works without internet and never sends your data anywhere.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: Ritu shares nothing. There are no ads, no analytics and no crash reporting. Data leaves the phone only when you export a file or a doctor report yourself.

pin.title: PINs
pin.body: A PIN is stored on this phone as a salted hash, never as the PIN itself. Locked profiles show only a name and a lock.

notify.title: Reminders
notify.body: Reminders are scheduled on the phone. By default they say only "Reminder – Tap to open".

export.title: Export and backup
export.body: You can export each profile as CSV and JSON, or save a backup file. Keep these files safe: anyone with the file can read it.

delete.title: Deleting data
delete.body: Delete a profile in its settings, or uninstall the app to delete everything. Deleted data cannot be recovered.

children.title: Children
children.body: A parent or guardian can create a profile for a child under 18. Fertile days are hidden by default and private notes are turned off for these profiles.

medical.title: Not medical advice
medical.body: Predictions are estimates, not medical advice and not birth control. Ritu never diagnoses; it only suggests when it may be worth seeing a doctor.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Ask the person or organisation that gave you this app, or the developer listed on the app store page.
